item.title: Ebola disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda
item.description: On 17 May 2026, the World Health Organization (WHO) declared the Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.
